# Kumma Wu

> Kumma Wu, Los Angeles. Trades options, builds software, reads old texts slowly, draws. The questions underneath: how to act when you cannot know, how understanding becomes judgment, and where leverage comes from (capital, software, knowledge, craft).

The fuller context is at https://kumma.me/llms-full.txt.

## Pages
- [Home](https://kumma.me/): who he is, in one page drawn by one red line.
- [Systems I build](https://kumma.me/work/): KOTA (restaurant phone calls into menu-verified kitchen tickets), ARCHON (an inspectable control plane for models, tools, memory and coding agents), Audiobook AI, a trade ledger, a voice-agent demo and an open stress suite for voice agents.
- [Notes](https://kumma.me/notes/): essays from his reading — on emotion, on faith and awareness, on Camus. Two also in Chinese.
- [Studies](https://kumma.me/studies/): drawing studies made live in the browser — bamboo in vermilion, an ensō, 道 in stroke order, a face as one spiral line.
